title: The new sky view reproduces the original measurement
summary: The wide radio viewer, its matched-beam overlay and the journal clock passed the local browser checks.

sections.heading: Three ways to check the view
body: At a 1,440 px viewport the PSZ2 G181 image was 1,382 × 625 display pixels. The rotated field has 562 × 254 samples and retains the release beam. Clicking Measure the relic separation switches to the matched beam.

The displayed T50-minus-T50SUB measurements remained −270.58 kpc at 600 kpc and −3.31 kpc at 300 kpc. The Abell 1925 view showed +116.05 kpc at the tighter aperture. Same settings and unchanged numerical results are the regression check for the viewer.

The journal projection demo went from 30° to 0° and back to the same −167 Myr reading. At 75° it stopped outside the calibrated range. A test run note imported into a separate test browser and survived a reload. Tested widths were 1,440, 390 and 320 px. Human review remains pending.

checks.title: Numerical regression
checks.result: All 27 radio cases matched the saved tables. The largest absolute difference was 3.12 × 10⁻⁷ kpc.

checks.title: Public clock check
checks.result: The standard-library calculation reproduces a −140.704 Myr sensitivity at the example 1,000 kpc radius.
